notes.title: Bug Fix Can't Launch the game (Hot Fix)
notes.content:
Apologize for the inconvenience this past days.
Been trying to fix the issue where most of the player can't launch the game.

If you one of those players.
Please follow the steps below.
100% sure to fix the game.

1. install the game. (if you haven't)
2. Right click on BAL Solid game in steam library and click browse local file.
3. if the folder inside the "Common/Bal Solid" is named "Bal Solid v103 steam".
Rename those folder to "Bal Solid"
4. Launch the game from steam.
5. it will redownload the 103 folder. but don't worry about that. (This is the issue)
6. Launch the game again from steam.

Thank you

notes.title: Bug Fix Steam achievements is not Triggered and Fatal Error on Exit.
notes.content:
Happy to announce!
[h1]New version is released.[/h1]

[h3]This version is mainly to fix 2 Major known issues.
- Steam Achievement is not triggered.
- Fatal Error on app exit.[/h3]

I apologize for the discomfort you as a player experience in the last version.
Note: For all player who want to sync their ingame achievement with steam achievement.
simply open achievement window.

Change log v103:
Bug fix.
- Steam achievement is not triggered properly.
- Fatal error on App Exit.

Fix
-Downgrade Steam SDK to 146
-Update how the achievement unlocked.
-Add new function to sync steam achievement when unlocking achievement window.

Why downgrade steam SDK?
Because I unknowingly update the SDK with unproper method, resulting in 2 most fatal bugs.
So I just revert the SDK to Engine Default. And it works fine.

Thank you for your patience in waiting the update.
I hope you enjoy the game.
Let me know if there are something to improve.
